The test class is complete and verified.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/LexerAgentTest.java` — 33 tests, all passing.

**Conventions matched** (from `ExtendedBufferedReaderTest`, `TokenMatchersTest`, `CSVRecordTest`): JUnit 4.11, `org.junit.Test` with `@Test`, static-imported `org.junit.Assert.*`, and the project's `TokenMatchers` hamcrest matchers (`matches`, `hasContent`, `isReady`) via `assertThat`. Like the project's own tests for other package-private support classes, `Lexer` (itself package-private and abstract) is exercised from within the package through its production subclass `CSVLexer`.

**Coverage:**

| Method | Tests |
|---|---|
| `readEscape()` | control-letter mapping (`r/n/t/b/f`), literal control chars, meta-chars returned verbatim, unknown char → `END_OF_STREAM` with offending char left on the reader, EOF → `IOException` (message asserted) |
| `readEndOfLine(int)` | `LF`/`CR`/non-terminator/`END_OF_STREAM` results; `CR`+`LF` pair swallows the `LF` (verified via next `read()` and line counter); lone `CR` does not consume the follower |
| `trimTrailingSpaces(StringBuilder)` | trailing spaces, no-op case, all-whitespace → empty, empty buffer, tab/CR/LF stripped while leading spaces kept |
| `getLineNumber()` | starts at 0, increments as records are consumed, stops at EOF |
| `isWhitespace` / `isStartOfLine` / `isEndOfFile` / `isDelimiter` / `isQuoteChar` / `isEscape` / `isCommentStart` | true/false cases incl. delimiter-exclusion, `UNDEFINED` vs `END_OF_STREAM`, and disabled (null) vs configured quote/escape/comment chars across `DEFAULT`, `TDF`, `MYSQL` and custom formats |
| `nextToken(Token)` | simple record, EOL handling, empty input (repeated EOF), encapsulated value, doubled quote, empty-line skipping vs `RFC4180` retention, comments (and mid-line `#` not treated as comment), escape-sequence processing, surrounding-space trimming vs retention, empty trailing token after delimiter, unterminated quote → `IOException`, stray char after closing quote → `IOException`, and token-instance reuse (`assertSame`) |

Verification:
- `defects4j compile` → OK (main + tests)
- `java -cp "$(defects4j export -p cp.test)" org.junit.runner.JUnitCore org.apache.commons.csv.LexerAgentTest` → `OK (33 tests)`
